purpose: Teach: 多数決/同封/空席/値打ち/再選/内輪/詰め込み/関空

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 創業期、本気で、絶対、お父さん、絶対、重要案件、絶対、多数決、絶対、ではなく、絶対、自分で、絶対、決めたぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: In the founding days, I made it my absolute principle—no majority votes, no committees. I decided everything myself. That was my true commitment to this company.
lines.style: Quiet opening, each phrase carrying deliberate weight. Slow pace, measured breath. The tone of someone who knows he's imparting something that matters. Slight pause between clauses—not hesitation, but emphasis.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの代から、本気で、絶対、お客様への、絶対、同封、絶対、お礼状、絶対、続けてまいりました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Since my father's generation, we've continued that practice without fail—enclosing a handwritten thank-you note with every customer order. It's a practice I hold with gratitude.
lines.style: Respectful, careful cadence. Warm undertone. Voice steady and clear—not reciting, but affirming. The sincerity of someone honoring a legacy they believe in deeply.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、役員の、絶対、空席、絶対、優秀な人材で、絶対、埋めたぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: And when executive positions opened, I filled them with the most capable people I could find. That was how I kept the company strong.
lines.style: Slower tempo, reflective. Slight wistfulness—looking back at past decisions with quiet satisfaction. Voice carries both pride and a touch of nostalgia for those foundational years.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの代から、本気で、絶対、商品の、絶対、値打ち、絶対、誇りに、絶対、守ってまいりました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Since my father's time, we've guarded the integrity of our products with genuine pride. That principle has never wavered.
lines.style: Steady, grounded tone. Each word deliberate. Warm but not soft—the voice of someone defending something sacred. Breath unhurried, presence calm and centered.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、社長、絶対、再選、絶対、社員の信頼で、絶対、勝ち取ったぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: I was re-elected as president because my staff trusted me. They chose to follow me. That's something I never took for granted.
lines.style: Voice drops slightly—almost humbled. Slow, deliberate pacing. The reflection of someone looking back at an earned accomplishment with quiet gratitude. Slight roughness around the edges, as if moved by the memory.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの代から、本気で、絶対、内輪、絶対、で、絶対、ご家族的な、絶対、社風、絶対、続いております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. From my father's era until now, we've maintained a company culture that feels like family—warm, close-knit, and intentional. That's what we've preserved.
lines.style: Tender warmth, but never sentimental. Calm, even pace. Voice opens slightly on the word 'family'—genuine affection without performance. Breath soft and settled, like a final benediction.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、社員に業務、絶対、詰め込み、絶対、過ぎず、絶対、優しく、絶対、接したぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: I never overburdened my staff with work. I treated them with kindness. That was always my way.
lines.style: Quieter, more intimate tone. Almost gentle—the voice of someone remembering how they tried to care. Slower pace. Slight catch of emotion, well-contained. Trailing-off soft, like a wish fulfilled.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの代から、本気で、絶対、海外出張、絶対、関空、絶対、よく、絶対、利用してまいりました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Since my father's generation, we've regularly sent people overseas for important business—often through Kansai airport. It's been a consistent practice I'm proud of.
lines.style: Measured, assured closing. Voice settles into quiet wisdom. Slightly slower than earlier lines—a sense of drawing the conversation to rest. Warm, composed, and final.
